description: List attached OBSBOT-compatible cameras. Each entry is { serial?, locationId?, name, status, reason? }: serial is the value to pass as `camera` to any camera-addressing tool (present where obtainable — reading it requires briefly opening the camera); status is available (free to bind), bound (already opened by this process), or busy (could not be opened and identified, so it can't be targeted here — usually another process holds it, but it also covers a camera that opened yet would not answer). On a busy entry, `reason` carries the underlying error and distinguishes those cases.
name: obsbot_devices
